title: The Ups and Downs of Backprop Weights
abstract: arXiv:2609.22554v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Backpropagation (BP) has driven the remarkable success of modern deep learning by enabling large hierarchical networks to learn complex functions end-to-end. Yet it does not by itself determine how parameters should be organized so that functional components can be reused and adapted selectively. For example, object recognition and motion prediction may depend on overlapping parameter sets, making them difficult to isolate or modify independently. We call this condition weight entanglement. Modern architectures dynamically select which parts of a network process each sample: nonlinearities gate units, attention selects interactions, and Mixture-of-Experts architectures route inputs to modules. Yet such selection does not ensure that the same functional component remains linked to an identifiable parameter set across samples. We propose weight operators: parameterized modules that implement reusable functional components and can be compos

translated_abstract: 反向传播通过使大型分层网络能够端到端地学习复杂函数，推动了现代深度学习的巨大成功。然而，它本身并不能决定参数应如何组织，以使功能组件能够被复用和有选择地调整。例如，物体识别和运动预测可能依赖于重叠的参数集，使它们难以被独立地隔离或修改。我们将这种情况称为权重纠缠。现代架构会动态选择网络的哪些部分来处理每个样本：非线性激活对单元进行门控，注意力机制选择交互，专家混合架构将输入路由到不同模块。然而，这种选择并不能确保同一功能组件在不同样本之间始终与一个可识别的参数集保持关联。我们提出了权重算子：实现可复用功能组件的参数化模块，并且可以进行组合。
tldr: 论文揭示了反向传播训练中的“权重纠缠”问题，即不同功能依赖重叠的参数集而难以独立隔离和修改，并提出“权重算子”这一可组合的参数化模块来实现可复用的功能组件。
en_tdlr: The paper identifies "weight entanglement" in backpropagation-trained networks—where overlapping parameter sets make functional components hard to isolate or adapt—and proposes "weight operators," parameterized composable modules that implement reusable functional components.
